title: Generation of vessel co-option lung metastases mouse models for single-cell isolation of metastases-derived cells and endothelial cells
protocol: Turn on the heating cage.
Wash RENCA /4T1 cells once with phosphate buffered saline (PBS).
Detach the cells with trypsin (1 mL for a cell culture flask T-75).
Add 9 mL RPMI 1640, resuspend and transfer to a 50 mL conical tube.
Count the cells using a counting chamber.
Transfer the required volume of the cell suspension (2 × 10^5 cells per mouse) into a new 50 mL conical tube.
Spin down the cells for 4 minutes at 145 g.
Aspirate the supernatant, add 5 mL PBS and resuspend thoroughly.
Spin down again for 4 minutes at 145 g.
Resuspend the cell pellet with PBS (100 μL/mouse).
Place the cell suspension on ice.
Place mice in heating cage for a few minutes.
Inject RENCA/4T1 cells (2 × 10^5 cells in 100 μL PBS) into tail vein using a 29G needle.
Fill a 100 mL glass bottle with 80 mL of reverse osmosis distilled water.
Add a stirring bar to the RO distilled water and place on a stirring plate at 20°C–22°C.
Dissolve 1.8 g of NaCl in the 80 mL of RO distilled water.
Add 0.4 mL of Tween 80 and stir for about 10 minutes until dissolved.
Add 0.9 mL of benzyl alcohol and let it stand for 5 minutes.
Gradually adjust the pH to 6 using small amounts (50–100 μL) of 0.5 M HCl or NaOH as needed.
Filter sterilize the solution into a clean bottle.
Add a stirring bar and place back on the stirring plate.
Slowly add 0.5 g of carboxymethylcellulose sodium.
Stir for 14–20 hours at 20°C–22°C.
Add another 20 mL of RO distilled water.
Store this control vehicle for up to one month at 4°C.
For oral dosing, add sunitinib malate powder (LC laboratories) to the control vehicle.
Vortex vigorously to create a suspension.
Calculate the average weight per treatment group.
Determine the number of treatment days for each group.
Count the number of mice in each treatment group.
Use the average weight to calculate the amount of sunitinib needed at 40 mg/kg/day.
Administer a gavage volume of 200 μL per mouse.
Preheat control vehicle to 37°C.
Add calculated amount of sunitinib powder to preheated control vehicle in a 50 mL tube.
Vortex vigorously until sunitinib forms a mixed suspension.
Prepare fresh stocks of sunitinib suspension weekly and store at 4°C in the dark.
Before dosing, vortex or draw up and down several times with syringe/gavage needle to mix settled drug.
Start treatment for RENCA model from day 10 after injection of RENCA cells.
Continue RENCA model treatment until day 20 or day 35.
Sacrifice mice on day 21 or day 36 and process lungs immediately.
Start treatment with sunitinib from day 3 after injection of 4T1 cells.
Continue sunitinib treatment for 10 days.
Sacrifice mice on day 13 of the experiment.
Process lungs immediately after sacrifice.
Check mice daily for signs of discomfort or illness.
Monitor breathing speed and pattern in mice.
Observe general behavior of mice.
Record bodyweight changes in mice.
Follow local/national animal welfare guidelines for monitoring.
Anesthetize mice with an intraperitoneal injection of ketamine (100 mg/kg body weight) and xylazine (10 mg/kg body weight).
Open the thoracic cavity.
Dissect both lungs and place them in a petri-dish on ice.
Micro-dissect at least 60 metastases per mouse under a dissection microscope using fine point tweezers.
Place dissected tissue immediately in a gentleMACS C tube containing 5 mL of lung digestion buffer.
Keep the tube and digestion buffer on ice.
Close the tube tightly.
Run the m_lung_01 protocol on the gentleMACSTM Dissociator.
Incubate for 30 minutes at 37°C.
Shake the tube vigorously by hand every 5 minutes during incubation.
Prepare 50 mL conical tubes with 40 μm cell strainers after 20 minutes of incubation.
Get MACS buffer out of the fridge.
Prepare 15 mL conical tubes.
Run the m_lung_02 protocol on the gentleMACSTM Dissociator.
Filter the cell suspension through a 40 μm cell strainer into a 50 mL conical tube.
Rinse the strainer with 5 mL MACS buffer and transfer the suspension to a 15 mL conical tube.
Centrifuge the cell suspension at 250 g for 5 min and aspirate the supernatant.
Place the tubes on ice, resuspend the cell pellet in 100 μL of MACS buffer and 100 μL of RBC lysis buffer.
Leave the mixture on ice for 1 min.
Place the mixture in a 37°C water bath for 2 min.
Dilute the cell suspension with 10 mL MACS buffer, pipet up and down.
Centrifuge the cell suspension at 250 g for 5 min and aspirate the supernatant.
Incubate tubes containing lung metastases in a gentleMACSTM Dissociator.
Run the m_lung_01 protocol (pre-programmed by manufacturer).
Shake the tube vigorously by hand every 5 minutes during incubation.
Place the tubes into a gentleMACSTM Dissociator and run the m_lung_02 protocol.
Filter the cell suspension through a 40 μm cell strainer into a 50 mL conical tube.
Rinse the strainer with 5 mL MACS buffer and transfer the suspension to a 15 mL conical tube.
Centrifuge the cell suspension at 250 g for 5 min.
Aspirate the supernatant from the centrifuged cell suspension.
Resuspend the cell pellet in 5 mL MACS buffer.
Pipet up and down with a pipette P1000 to mix the resuspended cells thoroughly.
Count the cells.
Centrifuge the cell suspension at 250 g for 5 min.
Aspirate the supernatant from the centrifuged cell suspension.
Add 80 μL MACS buffer, 10 μL CD45 MicroBeads, and 10 μL CD326 (EpCAM) MicroBeads to the cell pellet.
Resuspend the cells in 80 μL of MACS buffer.
Mix and incubate for 15 min at 4°C.
Wash the cells by adding 3 mL of MACS buffer and centrifuge at 250 g for 5 min at 4°C.
Aspirate the supernatant completely and resuspend the pellet in 0.5 mL of MACS buffer.
Place an MS column in the magnetic field of the suitable MACS Separator and rinse with 0.5 mL MACS buffer.
Apply the cell suspension from step iv onto the column through a 40 μm cell strainer (blue) and collect unlabeled cells that flow through in 15 mL conical tube.
Perform three washing steps with 0.5 mL MACS buffer each.
Centrifuge the flow-through at 250 g for 5 min at 4°C.
Add 90 μL MACS buffer and 10 μL CD31 MicroBeads to the cell pellet.
Mix thoroughly.
Incubate for 15 min at 4°C.
Wash the cells by adding 3 mL of MACS buffer.
Centrifuge at 250 g for 5 min at 4°C.
Aspirate the supernatant completely.
Resuspend the pellet in 0.5 mL of MACS buffer.
Place an MS column in the magnetic field of the suitable MACS Separator.
Rinse the column with 0.5 mL MACS buffer.
Apply the cell suspension onto the column.
Collect the unlabeled cells that flow-through in a 15 mL conical tube.
Perform three washing steps with 0.5 mL MACS buffer each, adding the MACS buffer once the column reservoir is empty after each wash.
Remove the column from the separator and place it on a 15 mL conical tube.
Pipette 1 mL MACS buffer onto the column immediately.
Flush out the magnetically labeled cells (CD31+) by firmly pushing the plunger into the column.
Centrifuge this fraction at 250 g for 5 min at 4°C.
Lung insufflation for immunohistochemistry.
Execute EdU staining to detect proliferating endothelial cells (ECs).
Perform ESM1/CD34 staining to identify tip ECs and EC markers.
Conduct CD31-podoplanin staining to mark endothelial cells and pneumocytes.
Score metastases as 'angiogenic' or 'vessel co-option' based on the presence of proliferating ECs, tip ECs, and EC sprouting patterns.
Anesthetize the mice with an intraperitoneal injection of ketamine (100 mg/kg body weight) and xylazine (10 mg/kg body weight).
Open the abdominal cavity.
Cut the diaphragm.
Open the thoracic cavity by cutting the ribs along the midclavicular line towards the clavicula, being careful not to touch the lungs.
Place the needle into the right ventricle for transcardial perfusion via the right ventricle.
Start perfusion with NaCl 0.9% at a rate of 2 mL/min for 5 min.
Make a tiny cut after 1 min in the left atrium and continue perfusion.
Start perfusion with paraformaldehyde 4% (PFA4%) at a rate of 2 mL/min for 5 min.
Place a silk suture thread under the teeth and fix with tape to stabilize the head.
Dissect the neck area.
Pull the salivary glands apart.
Clear the trachea externally by removing tissue on the sides of the trachea using blunt dissection with tweezers.
Carefully remove the transparent layer on top of the trachea with scissors.
Insert a 24G needle in the trachea, cranially from the knot.
Inject PFA 4% solution not too slowly or quickly and observe lung expansion.
Tighten the knot immediately after injection and make two extra knots.
Dissect the lungs.
Wash the lungs in PBS.
Leave the lungs for 14–20 h in PFA 4%.
After 24 h, wash the lungs three times with PBS.
Remove the silk suture thread.
Prepare the lungs for embedding.
Embed the lungs in paraffin.
Deparaffinize the tissue sections and rehydrate for 5 min with distilled water.
TrYPsinize the tissue sections for 7 min (1/80 in CaCl2 0.1%).
Wash the tissue sections 5 min with TBS (TRIS Buffered Saline).
Incubate for 20 min with MeOH/H2O2 (200 mL methanol plus 600 μL H2O2 30%) to block endogenous peroxidase activity.
Wash the tissue sections 3 × 5 min with TBS.
Apply protein block (Goat serum) 1/5 in TNB for 45 min to block nonspecific background staining.
Apply primary antibody Hamster anti-Podoplanin (DSHB 8.1.1-c) 1/500 in TNB.
Wash the tissue sections 3 × 5 min with TNT (TRIS-NaCl-TRITON Buffer).
Apply secondary antibody Goat anti-Hamster-B 1/200 in TNB for 45 min.
Wash the tissue sections 3 × 5 min with TNT.
Incubate for 30 min with Streptavidin-Peroxidase 1/100 in TNB.
Wash the tissue sections 3 × 5 min with TNT.
Incubate for 8 min with Cy3 1/50 in amplification diluent.
Wash the tissue sections 3 × 5 min with TNT.
Wash the tissue sections 5 min with TBS.
Incubate for 20 min with MeOH/H2O2 to block endogenous peroxidase activity.
Wash the tissue sections 3 × 5 min with TBS.
Apply protein block (Donkey serum) 1/5 in TNB for 45 min to block nonspecific background staining.
Apply primary antibody Rat anti-CD31 antibody 1/50 in TNB.
Wash the tissue sections 3 × 5 min with TNT.
Apply secondary antibody Donkey anti-Rat IgG, biotin-labeled at a dilution of 1/200 in TNB for 45 minutes.
Wash with TNT for 3 times, each for 5 minutes.
Incubate with Streptavidin-Peroxidase at a dilution of 1/100 in TNB for 30 minutes.
Wash with TNT for 3 times, each for 5 minutes.
Incubate with CY5 at a dilution of 1/50 in amplification diluent for 8 minutes.
Wash with TNT for 3 times, each for 5 minutes.
Incubate with Hoechst at a dilution of 1/500 in TNB for 30 minutes.
Wash with TNT for 3 times, each for 5 minutes.
Add Mount Prolong Gold medium without DAPI to cover the section.
Deparaffinize the tissue sections and rehydrate for 5 minutes with distilled water.
Perform antigen retrieval in Target Retrieval Solution pH6 at a concentration of 1X in milliQ water preheated to approximately 100°C for 20 minutes.
Cool down for 20 minutes.
Wash with TBS for 5 minutes.
Apply protein block (Donkey serum) at a dilution of 1/5 in TNB and incubate for 45 minutes.
Wash with TNT for 3 times, each for 5 minutes.
Apply primary antibody Goat anti-ESM-1 at a dilution of 1/50 in TNB.
Wash with TNT for 3 times, each for 5 minutes.
Add Donkey anti-goat-Alexa 488 at a dilution of 1/200 in TNB.
Wash with TNT for 3 times, each for 5 minutes.
Bring vials to 20°C–22°C before opening.
Add 2 mL DMSO (Component C) or an aqueous solution to Component A to make a 10 mM EdU stock solution.
Vortex the mixture and store at -20°C.
Prepare 1× Click-iT® EdU reaction buffer by adding 36 mL of deionized water to Component D.
Store the buffer at 2°–8°C.
Add 70 μL DMSO (Component C) to Component B to prepare Alexa Fluor® azide solution.
Mix well and store at -20°C.
Prepare 10× Click-iT® EdU buffer additive by adding 2 mL deionized water to the vial (Component F).
Mix until fully dissolved and store at -20°C.
Dilute Hoechst® 33342 1:2,000 in PBS to obtain a 1× solution.
Inject 40 μL of the EdU solution (10 mM; 0.1 mg in 40 μL) intraperitoneally, 5 mg/kg for 20 g mouse, 2 hours before sacrificing mice for histology.
Dissect and process the lungs as described in section 8.
Deparaffinize the tissue sections and rehydrate with distilled water for 5 minutes.
Rinse with TBS for 5 minutes.
Perform antigen retrieval in the oven for 20 minutes, followed by a cool down period of 20 minutes.
Wash with TBS for 5 minutes.
Rinse with PBS + 0.1% Triton X-100 at 20°C–22°C for 15 minutes.
Make 1× Click-iT® EdU buffer additive by diluting the 10× solution prepared above 1:10 in deionized water.
Use the 1× Click-iT® EdU buffer additive within 8 hours.

Apply the Click-iT® reaction cocktail at 4°C: Mix 430 μL of 1× Click-iT® EdU reaction buffer, 20 μL CuSO4, and 1.2 μL Alexa Fluor® azide – 555; then add 50 μL of the prepared 1× Click-iT® EdU buffer additive.
Rinse with PBS + 0.1% Triton X-100 at 20°C–22°C for 2 × 15 minutes.
Incubate to block endogenous peroxidase activity with MeOH/H2O2 for 20 minutes.
Wash with TBS for 3 × 5 minutes.
Apply protein block (Donkey serum) 1/5 in TNB for 45 minutes to block nonspecific background staining.
Apply Rat anti-CD34 (BD 553731) 1/25 in TNB.
Wash with TNT for 3 × 5 minutes.
Apply Donkey anti-Rat IgG, biotin-labeled at a dilution of 1/200 in TNB for 45 minutes.
Wash the sample three times for five minutes each with TNT.
Incubate with Streptavidin-Peroxidase at a dilution of 1/100 in TNB for 30 minutes.
Wash the sample three times for five minutes each with TNT.
Incubate with Cy5 Tyramide at a dilution of 1/50 in amplification diluent for eight minutes.
Wash the sample three times for five minutes each with TNT.
Incubate with Hoechst at a dilution of 1/500 in PBS for 30 minutes.
Wash the sample three times for five minutes each with TNT.
Add Mount Prolong Gold medium (without DAPI).
